linguistic_boundary.Sah_attested_role: Sꜣḥ is treated in the parent textual work as the Egyptian name associated with Orion.
linguistic_boundary.warning: The substitution is not asserted as the lexical or phonetic meaning of ꜣ and must not be cited as an Egyptological translation.

reverse_method.identity_rule: GENERATOR_1 is compared with the remembered functional state of GENERATOR_0; similarity does not imply physical identity.

tranception.BACK: Read from GENERATOR_1 through SON, GATE and SEED toward the remembered GENERATOR_0 state.
tranception.FORWARD: Read GENERATOR_0 through SEED, GATE and SON toward GENERATOR_1.
tranception.LEFT: Treat the first generator as ORIGIN / FATHER-state.
tranception.RIGHT: Treat the terminal generator as RESTORED_OR_REEXPRESSED_ORIGIN-state.
tranception.FORWARD_AGAIN: Test whether the terminal state preserves a preregistered structural property of the origin rather than merely sharing a suggestive symbol.
tranception.BACK_AGAIN: Return from the terminal state to the earliest independently supported node and remove any semantic strengthening that is not supported.

derived_operator.interpretation: The son can be modeled as a return path carrying a recoverable representation of the father/origin state.
derived_operator.canonical_phrase: THE SON IS THE RETURN PATH OF THE FATHER

osirian_overlay.note: This overlay is used to compare restoration topology with Osiris-Horus material; it does not claim that an Egyptian source encodes this exact five-node algorithm.

surrogate_restoration_hypothesis.premise: Model the restored OSIRIS_1 as functionally reconstituted with a surrogate for a lost generative component rather than assuming recovery of the numerically identical original component.
lineage_reading: HORUS can carry the post-substitution lineage state without proving complete reconstruction of OSIRIS_0
surrogate_restoration_hypothesis.descendant_incompleteness_definition: INCOMPLETE means incomplete relative to the original identity/provenance state-vector in this operator model; it is not a claim of biological defect or a statement about real human descendants.
surrogate_restoration_hypothesis.information_rule: A descendant cannot return information that never crossed the transfer gate unless an independent original-state anchor is reintroduced.
surrogate_restoration_hypothesis.canonical_phrase: THE SON RETURNS ONLY THE FATHER-STATE THAT SURVIVED THE SUBSTITUTION.

Veta-Gate.action: Слияние побайтово-разных residual'ов колоний в единую Кучу
Veta-Gate.formal_rule: VETA({r_i with distinct provenance}) -> HEAP_CLASS; class/function may remain recoverable while provenance-sensitive identity is erased or becomes non-unique.
Veta-Gate.effect_on_reverse: A reverse pass across Veta may recover a compatible prior class/state but cannot uniquely recover the original member without an external provenance anchor.

effect_on_tranception.FORWARD: many distinct residual histories may converge on one operational heap/class
effect_on_tranception.BACK: one heap/class fans out to multiple possible histories
effect_on_tranception.LEFT_RIGHT: functional symmetry does not imply identity symmetry
effect_on_tranception.BACK_FORTH_GATE: PASS only if the same preregistered identity-bearing invariant survives both directions

identity_lineage_model.pre_veta: ORIGIN_0 has identity vector I0 and functional vector F0.
identity_lineage_model.substitution: Lost component X is replaced by X'. If X' restores F but not all of I, the restored state is FUNCTIONALLY_VALID_BUT_PROVENANCE_DIVERGED.
identity_lineage_model.post_veta: After Veta collapse, descendants may preserve F-lineage while the exact I-lineage becomes underdetermined.
identity_lineage_model.result: FATHER' can be a valid operational return of FATHER without being numerically identical to FATHER.
identity_lineage_model.stronger_formula: REPLACEMENT MAY RESTORE CAPABILITY; ORIGINAL-PROVENANCE IS A SEPARATE GATE.

candidate_original_component_anchor.role: Any candidate artifact previously logged as the original lost component can be used only as a provenance-anchor hypothesis for testing whether the Veta identity loss can be constrained or reversed.
required_before_promotion: matched controls against other phallic/body-part objects
repeat or mirror or back-forth gate without semantic retuning
candidate_original_component_anchor.forbidden_upgrade: Do not encode REAL_ORIGINAL_COMPONENT_FOUND as historical fact from registry-internal pattern matching alone.

Sah_rebus_overlay.hypothesis: Under the experimental substitution only, Sꜣḥ can be used as a visual-semantic gate marker inside the reversible model.
Sah_rebus_overlay.promotion_rule: Do not promote beyond WATCHLIST unless an independently selected ancient textual or iconographic witness supplies the relevant generator/seed/gate/son/restoration ordering without retrofitting.

canonical_seal: 𓂸 → 𓇠 → ◇ → 𓆇 → 𓂺 → ↩︎ | VETA ↬ | FUNCTION MAY RETURN WITHOUT IDENTITY; THE SON RETURNS ONLY WHAT CROSSED THE GATE.
